items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 93:1
items.html: Because the second phase and the third phase came to him from the third division of Nekudim, therefore only what came out to him in the phase of Katnut remained with him, for whatever comes out from the beginning of Atzilut remains permanently fixed, as is the practice with ZON, as is known. (Inner Light, page 684, s.v. "in the manner")
